text:
ashley: quick check — prepping for SOC2 fieldwork next week, want to confirm owners for the remaining KMS/HSM artifacts and audit-log handoff. i have a short snag list.
ben: +1, drop the list please. i can take any infra PRs.
ashley: thanks. items: 1) HSM attestation doc finalization 2) audit-log streaming proof (nonprod) 3) retention proof for keys 4) deploy gating for keystore-migration PRs
carmen: for audit-log streaming — who owns the backfill + proof that nonprod logs include KMS events? i can help validate ingestion but need the query pattern.
sam: i wrote a small backfill helper last month. can link. it expects logs in stackdriver format; query is basically `resource.type="gce_instance" AND jsonPayload.eventType:"kms"` — might need tweaks for HSM fields.
ben: PRs to watch: #4291 keystore-migration (infra) and #4320 hsm-attestation (docs). both in my queue. i can try to push review on #4291 by EOD.
julian: product asks for retention evidence showing policy applied to customer keys older than 90d. we need a sampling plan and owner to run it.
ashley: ok assign owners: HSM attestation doc -> julian to draft final language, ben to review. Audit-log streaming proof + backfill -> carmen + sam. Retention sampling -> ashley + product (julian) to define scope. keystore-migration gating -> ben owner, sam support.
carmen: for backfill, i'll need the sample query + the timeframe. sam, can you post the script & a sample result snippet?
sam: putting script in #eng-infra gist now. snippet below:
```
# fetch kms events last 30d
gcloud logging read 'jsonPayload.serviceName="kms.googleapis.com"' --limit 50 --format json
```
example output: `{ "jsonPayload": { "eventType": "Encrypt", "keyId": "projects/..../keyR" }}`
ben: thanks. if we can get 3 examples (nonprod), that's good enough for audit. i'll include that in PR #4291 description.
julian: i'll draft the retention scope doc today and ping legal for wording. ashley, can you confirm the sampling window (30 vs 90 days)?
ashley: let's go with 90d sampling for production keys, 30d for nonprod. julian pls note that in doc.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: keystore-migration v2 -> staging at 2026-03-18T14:12:00Z (pipeline 884)
ben: noted deploy. if staging run succeeds, i'll cut a canary and tag the audit artifacts.
carmen: once backfill results are ready, i'll validate 3 example events and stamp `evidence:verified` in the ticket.
sam: linked gist: https://gist.github.com/sam/kms-backfill-sample
ashley: action items recap in thread: HSM attestation doc (julian -> draft by 03/19), PR reviews (#4291 ben -> EOD), backfill & proof (sam+carmen -> sample results by 03/19), retention sampling scope (julian + ashley -> 03/19). anyone want to adjust?
ben: all good from infra side.
julian: on it, will post draft in ~3h.
carmen: i'll start validation once gist is live.
ashley: thanks team :thumbsup:
ben: :+1:
sam: :party_parrot:
